title: Trump rejects pause in AI race citing competition from China

title: Left and right neck-and-neck as far right loses ground in Sweden

title: 'The Abraham Accords have fueled war rather than peace in the Middle East'
subhead: The agreements were signed six years ago, but instead of leading to a broader normalization between Israel and the Arab world, they have instead deepened divisions in the Middle East, analyzes columnist Jean-Pierre Filiu.
